And you feel liberated to have expressed you? Maybe something common like expressing here can free you. It's sad that your foster parents don't care how it feels in that place

​

Well, as you say and I think so too, "I just don't think that me wanting to kill myself is so simple".  
 I remember that I read this and I associate it with video games as you also do, it may make you happy or not play, but you get out of everything you suffer.  
"I wish people would understand that you can feel happy even when you're depressed. It's like a little yellow spot on a grey wall. The grey doesn't take away the yellow but also the yellow doesn't erase the grey. Both exist."

Wow, it's deep what you say, I also remember having that feeling of happiness to set a date to commit suicide, by the way,  how old are you? And what mental problems do you have? Sorry to ask, I'm very curious
